messages:
maria: Heads-up for the joint marketplace/HW SI listing 1: we need a compact compliance bundle to attach to the listing review. Can folks confirm a minimal acceptable set so we can ask partners for a scoped upload?
kevin: Minimal bundle from security: SOC 2 executive summary (1-2 pages), pen-test exec summary (redact customer data), the SIintegration questionnaire (signed), firmware attestation letter (if devices included), and a single index file mapping files to owners.
anya: Ops: ensure transfer uses our intake portal (secure-upload.redwood.com) with upload audit on. require SHA256 checksums and the KMS key id used to encrypt any archives. We need file hashes to auto-verify.
raj: Legal: we need an assessor attestation page (scanned) and evidence theyve disclosed any customer-impacting findings per our disclosure policy. If partner refuses full reports, accept a signed assessor attestation + redacted summary. NDAs must be in place before full reports.
maria: okay so minimum filenames and format? kevin/anya can you propose canonical names so automation can pick them up?
kevin: suggested names: soc2_exec_summary.pdf, pen_exec_summary.pdf, si_questionnaire_signed.pdf, firmware_attestation.pdf, artifact_index.csv, assessor_attestation.pdf, checksums.sha256
anya: add chain_of_custody.log and kms_key_id.txt. If there are firmware blobs, include firmware_manifest.csv with columns: filename, version, checksum, signer.
marketplace-bot: Note : marketplace schema requires metadata.compliance.bundle_version and metadata.compliance.receipt_ts for ingestion. Missing fields will cause a publish hold.
raj: also require a short remediation plan for any open pen findings (timeline + owner). can be a single PDF: remediation_plan.pdf.
maria: timeline: were aiming to submit listing artifacts by Tue EOD. Can partners deliver minimal bundle by then and full package (redacted full report + assessor contact + legal docs) within 10 business days?
kevin: i'll send the request template to partners now (includes acceptable redaction patterns, examples). will cc security assessor verification contact.
anya: Ops will provision one-time upload links for each partner and rotate creds after ingestion. we'll post links here once ready.
raj: i'll prep a short legal checklist and confirm NDAs. if partner is a device vendor, confirm firmware signing chain before we accept images.
maria: thanks. once i have responses i'll log status in the marketplace tracker and ping eng/product for final sign-off. please react with :white_check_mark: when done reviewing the bundle ask.
ops-bot: Upload links will be live in channel in ~30m and expire in 7 days.
kevin: draft request is at https://redwood.internal/drive/marketplace/minimal_bundle_req_v2.md 
maria: perfect 1. posting this to the partners thread now. will follow up with owners next steps.
